verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: Failure and recovery semantics: deadline-aware admission overload, exhaustive pre-token classification, ordered fallback with fresh deadlines and stable identifiers, immediate non-retryable errors, and the no-silent-retry rule after streaming begins.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: The shadow-evaluation path says “structured eval sample” but does not visibly preserve the brief's qualifier that the mirrored sample is small.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board represents all system-defining requirements and nearly every supporting qualifier. Admission, tier routing, caching, heterogeneous capacity, streaming, fallback, circuit breaking, accounting, spend control, and shadow-result isolation are all visibly covered and connected. The only partial requirement is the omitted “small” qualifier on the structured evaluation sample.
